svg.title: Experience timeline
svg.text: Shipped Warrant, a self-proposed capstone: a provenance-based tool-authorization security layer for
AI agents, approved by mentor review.
Built a production RAG shopping assistant grounded in live inventory data, cut API response times
~35%, and lifted Lighthouse scores by 20 points.
Leads AI-focused workshops and hands-on sessions for the student builder community, mentoring peers
on applied AI and cloud projects.
